title: Binance CEO says 90 percent of stolen assets have been ‘replenished’

claims.claim: Hackers stole $6.3 billion from Binance customers in a crypto heist.

evidence.quote: After hackers stole a shocking $6.3 billion from Binance customers in a record-breaking crypto heist
After hackers stole a shocking $6.3 billion from Binance customers in a record-breaking crypto heist...

claims.claim: Binance CEO stated that 90 percent of the stolen funds have been replaced.

evidence.quote: the company’s CEO says that 90 percent of the funds have been replaced
After hackers stole a shocking $6.3 billion from Binance customers in a record-breaking crypto heist, the company’s CEO says that 90 percent of the funds have been replaced...

claims.claim: Binance plans to cover the remaining 10 percent of the stolen funds.

evidence.quote: the company plans to cover the remaining 10 percent as well.
...and the company plans to cover the remaining 10 percent as well.

claims.claim: The remaining 10 percent consists of less liquid tokens which may take longer to acquire.

evidence.quote: the remaining 10 percent consists of “less liquid” tokens, which the company says may take longer to acquire.
Binance is covering the stolen funds directly, and the remaining 10 percent consists of “less liquid” tokens, which the company says may take longer to acquire.

claims.claim: Withdrawals on Binance remain paused following the incident.

evidence.quote: while withdrawals remain paused
The company also said in a post on X that, while withdrawals remain paused, they’re on track to be enabled on Sunday.

claims.claim: Binance stated in a post on X that withdrawals are on track to be enabled on Sunday.

evidence.quote: The company also said in a post on X that, while withdrawals remain paused, they’re on track to be enabled on Sunday.

claims.claim: Binance scheduled the reopening of withdrawals for Sunday, 2026-11-01.

evidence.quote: We remain on track to reopen withdrawals within our previously stated timeframe (on Sunday, 2026-11-01)
We remain on track to reopen withdrawals within our previously stated timeframe (on Sunday, 2026-11-01) and will provide a further update as soon as details are confirmed.
